nodes.long_description:
1. place a piece of parchment paper on the scale and tare it to zero.
Weigh out 7 grams of sulfur powder
2. add 7 g of sulfur to test tubes A and B.
3. measure 4 g of iron powder and add it to test tubes A and B. 
Add 11 g of only sulfur powder to C and 11 g of only iron powder to D.
4. vigorously mix the iron and sulfur powder in test tubes A and B.
5. heat test tube A with sulfur and iron powder with a blowtorch.
6. Place a magnet on test tubes A through D and observe the results.
7. move the test tubes A through D to the fume hood (a laboratory apparatus with ventilation holes).
8. prepare the hydrochloric acid
9. add hydrochloric acid to test tubes A through D
10. add hydrochloric acid to test tubes A through D and observe
Students will learn about mixtures of iron and sulfur and how the compounds change.
nodes.short_description: Understand the difference between mixtures and compounds in this interactive experiment. It's a great way to learn about chemical bonding, molecular structures, and the properties that distinguish mixtures from pure substances.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
